socket_headgear.note: IDENTITY by construction: every headgear GLB is authored with its vertices already expressed directly in mixamorig:Head bone-local space (measured by baking the welded pith_helmet/rice_hat's true world position through (rig.matrix_world @ Head-pose-bone.matrix).inverted() - see nva_vc/props build script). A BoneAttachment3D on mixamorig:Head with this (identity) local transform, holding the mesh as a direct child, reproduces the fitted position exactly. This differs from assets/us/props/helmets/helmets.json, whose socket carries a non-identity rotation because that helmet was authored in a different reference frame - the two are not interchangeable, each is correct for its own asset family.

socket_pack.note: IDENTITY by the same construction, on mixamorig:Spine1 (upper-mid back). Placement was measured against grunt_torso's own back surface at spine height (see build script) - frame/body sits ~2cm clear of the torso mesh.

dresser_contract_note: vc_nva_dresser.gd's GEAR_TOGGLES only TOGGLES VISIBILITY of meshes already welded into the character body (by substring match on 'pack_worn'/'pack_roll'/'foliage_back'/'foliage_headgear'); it has no re-hang path for a separate prop library the way _rehang_headgear() does for HEADGEAR. All pack meshes here are named with the 'pack_worn'/'pack_roll' substrings per the letter of that contract, but wiring this library in requires a new _rehang_pack()-style function mirroring _rehang_headgear() (same BoneAttachment3D pattern, on socket_pack above) - it does not work automatically today. This needs a code change to actually reach these props at runtime.
